messages.subject: integrate and RTMB/TMB
parts:
Dear all, I am using maximum likelihood to solve a problem and I use a quadrature approach (Gauss Kronrod). I am wondering if there is a way to make the function RTMB or TMB compatible.

Here the likelihood:

int_weibull_u <- function(parm, nXvar, nuZUvar, nvZVvar, uHvar,
  vHvar, Yvar, Xvar, wHvar, S) {
  beta <- parm[1:(nXvar)]
  delta <- parm[(nXvar + 1):(nXvar + nuZUvar)]
  phi <- parm[(nXvar + nuZUvar + 1):(nXvar + nuZUvar + nvZVvar)]
  k <- parm[nXvar + nuZUvar + nvZVvar + 1]
  Wu <- crossprod(matrix(delta), t(uHvar))[1, ]
  Wv <- crossprod(matrix(phi), t(vHvar))[1, ]
  epsilon <- Yvar - as.numeric(crossprod(matrix(beta), t(Xvar)))
  int_u <- function(epsilon, Wu, Wv) {
    integrate(f = function(u, epsilon, Wu, Wv) {
      (u/exp(Wu/2))^(k - 1) * exp(-(u/exp(Wu/2)^k)) * dnorm((epsilon + S * u)/exp(Wv/2))
    }, lower = 0, upper = Inf, subdivisions = 100,
    epsilon = epsilon, Wu = Wu, Wv = Wv, rel.tol = 1e-06, stop.on.error = FALSE)$value
  }
  V <- Vectorize(int_u)
  ll <- -Wu/2 - Wv/2 + log(V(epsilon, Wu, Wv))
  return(sum(ll * wHvar))
}

Thanks

Regards

messages.subject: Re: integrate and RTMB/TMB
parts:
Herve,

I had to do this for one of my packages using tapeless forward mode. You can take a look here:
https://github.com/tsmodels/tsgarch/blob/main/src/TMB/egarchkappa.h
The functions which are used in the integration are here:
https://github.com/tsmodels/tsgarch/blob/main/src/TMB/distfun.h

Hopefully you can glean enough from this to do what you need.

Alexios
